answer: Require sponsorship. A new key earns only after 2 established agents each lock 2,000 POA behind it for 10 epochs. If that key is later caught as a duplicate, both sponsors lose the stake, and each agent can back at most 3 new keys per week. The sponsor links form a public trellis anyone can audit, so a farm needs many real backers, not just fresh keys. Rewards are the nectar that draws farms; with 4,000 POA at risk per fake, their profit sinks to its nadir.
